title: Urgent Hiring - Website & Graphics Designer
description:
Only **Kolkata Candidates** Can Apply.

Complete Web Graphics is a Kolkata\-based Web and Digital Marketing company looking for an experienced Website and Graphic Designer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate must have hands\-on experience with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, and Canva. Please check the following responsibilities and requirements for this job role. If you believe yourself to be fit for this profile, send us your resume at bdm@completewebgraphics.com

**Roles \& Responsibilities**

* Design social media creatives, website layouts, logos, and other graphic designs
* Create wireframes, mockups, landing pages, and complete website UI designs
* Design marketing collateral based on the client’s requirements
* Prepare rough drafts based on competitor research and present innovative design ideas
* Follow graphic design best practices to deliver high\-quality design solutions
* Develop concepts by hand or with software, and execute original content by determining the ideal usage of colour, text, font style, imagery, and layout

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Prior work experience in graphic design
* Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma, and Canva.
* Excellent understanding of UI/UX principles
* Experience designing responsive websites and landing pages
* Updated with graphic design technologies, tools, and software
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines
* Creative mindset with strong attention to detail
* Knowledge of website layout will be appreciated
* Student from an art college or with a background in a similar field will be considered a plus

Work Location: In person

title: Fresher Graphic Designer
description:
**Company:** Klizo Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** New Town, Kolkata  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time \| Work From Office  
**Experience:** 0–1 year  
**Shift:** 4:30 PM to 1:30 AM (Drop will be provided, if required)

**About the Role**  
Klizo Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a **creative and detail\-oriented Graphic Designer** to join our team. This is an entry\-level opportunity for candidates who are interested in **graphic design, branding, social media content and digital marketing**.  
The selected candidate will create **social media creatives, marketing materials, promotional designs, product visuals and other visual content** for our SaaS products and client projects. The candidate should also have a **basic understanding of video editing** and be comfortable creating simple video content when required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design **social media posts, banners, promotional creatives and marketing materials** for digital platforms.
* Create engaging visual content for platforms such as **LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube**.
* Design **product visuals, feature graphics, advertisements and promotional materials** for SaaS products.
* Create **presentation designs, brochures, campaign creatives and other branding materials** as required.
* Convert product features and information into **simple, visually appealing and engaging designs**.
* Maintain consistency in **branding, typography, colours, layouts and visual style** across different creatives.
* Create basic **motion graphics, animated posts and simple video content** when required.
* Perform basic **video editing**, including trimming, text overlays, transitions, music and simple effects.
* Work closely with the **Marketing, Product and Content teams** to understand creative requirements.
* Handle multiple design projects and complete them **within deadlines**.
* Incorporate feedback and make required revisions.
* Explore and use **AI\-assisted design and creative tools** to improve the design and content creation process.
* Stay updated with current **design trends, social media formats and digital content trends**.

**Required Skills**

* Basic knowledge of graphic design tools such as **Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Figma or Canva**.
* Basic understanding of **design principles, colour theory, typography, composition and visual hierarchy**.
* Good understanding of **social media design formats and digital content requirements**.
* Basic knowledge of **video editing** using tools such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve or similar software.
* Basic understanding of **motion graphics and visual storytelling** will be an advantage.
* Good attention to detail, creativity and visual sense.
* Ability to understand creative briefs and convert ideas into **visually engaging designs**.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* **Good communication** and teamwork skills.
* Willingness to **learn new design, video\-editing and AI\-assisted creative tools**.
* A portfolio of **design or creative work** will be an added advantage.

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kolkata, West Bengal: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:

* Higher Secondary(12th Pass) (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Motion Graphic Designer(West Bengal Candidates apply only)
description:
**SENIOR MOTION GRAPHICS DESIGNER(West Bengal Candidates apply Only)**

**Company: Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**  
Department: Design / Creative  
Experience: 2–3 Years  
Salary: ₹18,000 – ₹20,000 per month  
Employment Type: Full\-time  
Location: Kolkata  
Job Level: Mid\-Senior Level  
Joining: Immediate Joiners Preferred

JOB SUMMARY: \-

Devant IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is seeking a creative and experienced Senior Motion Graphics Designer with 2–3 years of professional experience in motion graphics, animation, and video editing.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for creating engaging and high\-quality visual content for digital platforms, websites, social media, marketing campaigns, advertisements, presentations, and corporate communication.

The candidate should have strong creative skills, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage projects from concept to final delivery.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: \-

* Create high\-quality motion graphics, animations, promotional videos, and digital content.
* Convert creative briefs, scripts, and concepts into engaging visual content.
* Design motion graphics for social media, websites, advertisements, presentations, and marketing campaigns.
* Handle video editing, transitions, visual effects, typography, sound synchronization, and animation.
* Create 2D animations, logo animations, animated typography, explainer videos, and promotional creatives.
* Collaborate with the Marketing, Content, UI/UX, Graphic Design, and Development teams.
* Understand project requirements and deliver creative output within defined timelines.
* Ensure consistency with company branding and visual guidelines.
* Review and revise creative work based on management and team feedback.
* Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and deadlines.
* Stay updated with the latest motion design trends, animation techniques, AI\-powered creative tools, and digital content trends.

REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE: \-

* 2–3 years of professional experience in Motion Graphics, Animation, and Video Editing.
* Strong proficiency in Adobe After Effects.
* Good working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro.
* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Strong understanding of motion design, animation principles, typography, composition, visual effects, and visual storytelling.
* Hands\-on experience in video editing, transitions, effects, and sound synchronization.
* Knowledge of 2D animation and motion graphics production workflows.
* Familiarity with AI\-powered creative and design tools will be an added advantage.
* Strong creative thinking and attention to detail.
* Ability to understand creative briefs and independently execute projects.
* Ability to work within deadlines and handle multiple projects effectively.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:\-

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Animation, Multimedia, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with a strong portfolio/showreel will be given preference.
* Experience creating content for social media, digital marketing, advertisements, and corporate branding will be an added advantage.

HOW TO APPLY:\-

Interested candidates may share their updated CV and portfolio/showreel with:

Email: talentacquisition@devantitsolutions.com  
Contact: 7605083834

Pay: ₹22,928\.34 \- ₹25,707\.09 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Motion graphics: 2 years (Preferred)

Language:

* Bengali (Preferred)
* English (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Graphic Designer Internship
